definition: A 3-digit integer issued by a server in response to a client's HTTP request, indicating whether the request succeeded or failed.
detailedExplanation: Status codes fall into 5 categories: 1xx (Informational), 2xx (Success), 3xx (Redirection), 4xx (Client Error), and 5xx (Server Error). Standard OpenAPI specs should explicitly document status codes expected per operation.
commonMistakes: Using 500 Internal Server Error for validation failures
relatedToolTitle: Audit Error Status Codes with APIForge
